## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] The Python tests (`pytest test/python`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] If `check_text.py` changed: the real-figure regression was run and compared (`eval/text/`)
- [ ] If the skill's documents changed: fresh Codex sessions were run and their measurements added to `CALIBRATION.md` (sessions and generations spent: )
- [ ] `README.md` and `README.zh-CN.md` agree, and `CHANGELOG.md` is updated
